A calendar established by [[Artur Hawkwing]] during his reign, the years of '''From the Founding (FF)''' replaced the system of the [[Free Years]]. This system lasted for the shortest time of all known calendar systems, lasting only until after the [[War of the Hundred Years]], when it was replaced by the [[Calendar|Farede]] calendar. In the present time, Hawkwing's calendar is only referred to by historians.
